He previously pleaded guilty and today (19 November) was fined £3,072 and ordered to pay costs of £2,836.Having risen to fame on Geordie Shore, Chalmers has more than 2 million followers on Instagram. Agbodza, 35, of London, was also fined £1,173 and ordered to pay costs of £2,114 after pleading guilty.Both men encouraged followers to invest in foreign exchange (forex or FX) trading through contracts for difference (CFDs), without being authorised to promote them.
